review:
One of BGaming's oldest games, from 2016 – classic Egyptian theme, hand-drum music and nine lines. No gimmicks: wilds, scatters and free spins.

The maths is what makes it worth playing. Free spins come round about once every 57 spins on average, which is very frequent, and the RTP is 97.13%. The ceiling is modest at 1,939x with medium-high volatility. A retro pick for long, chilled demo sessions rather than chasing huge wins.
pros: Excellent 97.13% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 57 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
